description: Synthetic compatibility vectors. Null schema expectation means strict JSON decoding was rejected, so structural validation is deliberately unassessed. Direct typed and bounded_typed use the manifest's base-message parser; bounded_typed additionally applies the declared byte/depth/node limits and strict JSON checks. Route schemas and cross-message/context checks are separate. Canonical expectations concern direct typed parsing, independent of strict/bounded acceptance. No fixture is scientific or authorization evidence.
